proof_requests: Video of the AC powered on, running continuously for several minutes showing cold air output and outdoor fan/compressor operating with normal sound.
Clear close-up photo of the manufacturer nameplate/model sticker on both indoor and outdoor units.
Photo of the original receipt and warranty card with legible date, serial number, and purchaser name.
Photo showing remote control, mounting bracket, and copper pipes included with the unit.
Clarification from seller resolving the contradiction between 'faulty' in the title and 'no fault at all' in the description.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a split AC indoor/outdoor set, but function, capacity, and completeness are unverifiable remotely, and the seller's own words contradict each other on fault status, so it must be priced at worst case (assume faulty, unit-only) pending the listed proofs.
